title: Oklahoma 17, Missouri 6: Sategna's 87-Yard Score and a Defensive Stand
question: What was the score of Oklahoma vs. Missouri on November 22, 2025?
answer: Oklahoma beat Missouri 17-6 in Norman on November 22, 2025. The Sooners gained just 276 yards but got an 87-yard touchdown catch from Isaiah Sategna, four sacks, and a second-half shutout from the defense.
summary: Oklahoma beat Missouri 17-6 on Nov. 22, 2025: Isaiah Sategna's 87-yard score, four sacks and a second-half shutout moved the Sooners toward the playoff.
body: On Saturday, November 22, 2025, No. 8 Oklahoma hosted Missouri in Norman and won 17-6. It was not a pretty offensive day, but it was exactly the kind of win a playoff-hopeful team needs in late November.

The Sooners finished with only 276 total yards, fewer than the 301 Missouri gathered. What Oklahoma did have was a big play. Quarterback John Mateer found Isaiah Sategna on a short throw in the second quarter, and Sategna turned it into an 87-yard touchdown that put the Sooners up 7-3.

The defense then took over. Missouri did not score at all in the second half, and all four Oklahoma sacks came from the defensive front. Tigers running back Ahmad Hardy was held to 57 yards on 17 carries.

Kicker Tate Sandell added a 45-yard field goal on the opening drive of the third quarter to make it 17-6. It was his 22nd straight made field goal, a school record at that point. Mateer also contributed 60 yards on the ground.
The win lifted Oklahoma to 9-2 overall and 5-2 in the SEC, and left the Sooners hosting LSU the next Saturday with a playoff spot within reach.
